```{r setup}
library(pracma)
library(plotly)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(nloptr)

# Загрузка данных наблюдений
shadow_data <- read_csv('lab/extra/nonlinear/shadow.csv')

# Константы задачи
constants <- list(
  R = 8.31,           # Дж/(К·моль)
  M = 28.97e-3,       # кг/моль (переводим в кг)
  g = 9.8,            # м/с^2
  gamma = 7/5,
  P_a = 101.3e3,      # Па
  Lambda = 0.6,
  tau = 2e-3,
  rho_0 = 1.20,       # кг/м^3
  Gamma = 1,
  A_r = 1.2,
  A_n = 1.6,
  V_1 = 7.9e3,        # м/с
  h_0 = 100e3,        # м
  epsilon = 0.9,
  sigma = 5.67e-8,    # Вт/(м^2·К^4)
  psi = 1,
  amu = 1.66e-27,     # кг
  k_B = 1.38e-23,     # Дж/К
  T_0 = 288.15,       # К (15°C)
  
  # Характеристики алюминия
  T_B = 2470 + 273.15, # К
  c = 930,             # Дж/(кг·К)
  L_f = 390e3,         # Дж/кг
  L_b = 10.53e6,       # Дж/кг
  mu = 27 * 1.66e-27,  # кг
  
  # Характеристики спутника 3U
  length = 0.30,       # м
  width = 0.10,        # м
  height = 0.10,       # м
  density_al = 2700    # кг/м^3
)

# Расчет параметров спутника
satellite <- list(
  volume = constants$length * constants$width * constants$height,
  mass_0 = constants$length * constants$width * constants$height * constants$density_al,
  surface_area = 2 * (constants$length * constants$width + 
                     constants$length * constants$height + 
                     constants$width * constants$height),
  cross_section = constants$length * constants$width
)

# Теплота абляции
constants$L = constants$L_f + constants$L_b
```


```{r}
# Функции атмосферы
atmosphere_temperature <- function(h) {
  if (h < 0) h <- 0
  
  T_0 <- constants$T_0
  gamma <- constants$gamma
  M <- constants$M
  g <- constants$g
  R <- constants$R
  
  T_a <- T_0 - (gamma - 1) / gamma * M * g * h / R
  
  # Ограничение минимальной температуры
  if (T_a < 50) T_a <- 50  # Минимум 50 К
  
  return(T_a)
}

atmosphere_density <- function(h) {
  # Ограничение высоты
  if (h < 0) h <- 0
  if (h > 200000) h <- 200000
  
  T_a <- atmosphere_temperature(h)
  
  # Проверка на корректность температуры
  if (is.na(T_a) || T_a <= 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  rho_a <- constants$rho_0 * (T_a / constants$T_0)^(1/0.26)
  
  # Ограничение минимальной плотности
  if (rho_a < 1e-12) rho_a <- 1e-12
  
  return(rho_a)
}
```

```{r}
# Матрица поворота
rotation_matrix <- function(alpha, beta, gamma) {
  matrix(c(
    cos(beta) * cos(gamma), 
    sin(alpha) * sin(beta) * cos(gamma) - cos(alpha) * sin(gamma),
    cos(alpha) * sin(beta) * cos(gamma) + sin(alpha) * sin(gamma),
    cos(beta) * sin(gamma),
    sin(alpha) * sin(beta) * sin(gamma) + cos(alpha) * cos(gamma),
    cos(alpha) * sin(beta) * sin(gamma) - sin(alpha) * cos(gamma),
    -sin(beta),
    sin(alpha) * cos(beta),
    cos(alpha) * cos(beta)
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
}

# Вычисление площади проекции для заданных углов поворота
projection_area <- function(alpha, beta, gamma) {
  vertices <- matrix(c(
    0, 0, 0,
    constants$length, 0, 0,
    constants$length, constants$width, 0,
    0, constants$width, 0,
    0, 0, constants$height,
    constants$length, 0, constants$height,
    constants$length, constants$width, constants$height,
    0, constants$width, constants$height
  ), nrow = 8, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Поворот и проекция
  rot_mat <- rotation_matrix(alpha, beta, gamma)
  projected <- t(rot_mat[1:2, ] %*% t(vertices))

  hull_indices <- chull(projected)
  area <- abs(polyarea(projected[hull_indices, 1], projected[hull_indices, 2]))
  
  return(area)
}

effective_area_rotating <- function(omega_alpha, omega_beta, omega_gamma) {
  max_omega <- max(omega_alpha, omega_beta, omega_gamma)
  
  if (max_omega > 1) {
    return(satellite$surface_area / 4)
  } else {
    n_samples <- 20
    time_samples <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n_samples)
    areas <- sapply(time_samples, function(t) {
      alpha <- omega_alpha * t
      beta <- omega_beta * t
      gamma <- omega_gamma * t
      projection_area(alpha, beta, gamma)
    })
    return(mean(areas))
  }
}
```

```{r}

satellite_ode <- function(t, y, omega_params) {
  h <- y[1]
  v <- y[2]
  m <- y[3]
  T <- y[4]
  
  # Спутник почти полностью сгорел
  if (!is.na(m) && m < satellite$mass_0 * 0.01) {
    return(c(0, 0, 0, 0))
  }
  
  T_a <- atmosphere_temperature(h)
  rho_a <- atmosphere_density(h)

  omega_alpha <- omega_params[1]
  omega_beta <- omega_params[2]
  omega_gamma <- omega_params[3]
  
  max_omega <- max(omega_alpha, omega_beta, omega_gamma)
  if (max_omega > 1) {
    S_e <- satellite$surface_area / 4
  } else {
    S_e <- satellite$cross_section
  }
  
  # Скорость абляции
  dmdt <- 0
  if (!is.na(T) && !is.na(T_a) && T > T_a && T > 0) {
    exp_term <- exp(-constants$L * constants$mu / (constants$k_B * T))
    if (!is.na(exp_term) && is.finite(exp_term)) {
      dmdt <- S_e * constants$psi * 
        constants$P_a * exp(constants$L * constants$mu / (constants$k_B * constants$T_B)) * 
        exp_term / sqrt(2 * pi * constants$k_B * T / constants$mu)
    }
  }
  
  dhdt <- -v 
  
  dvdt <- constants$Gamma * rho_a * v^2 * S_e / m
  
  energy_in <- constants$Lambda * rho_a * v^3 * S_e / 2
  energy_out_radiation <- 4 * constants$sigma * constants$epsilon * 
                         (T^4 - T_a^4) * satellite$surface_area
  energy_out_ablation <- constants$L * dmdt
  
  dTdt <- (energy_in - energy_out_radiation - energy_out_ablation) / (constants$c * m)
  
  return(c(dhdt, dvdt, -dmdt, dTdt))
}

smart_integration <- function(satellite_ode, t0, tfinal_max, y0, omega_params, dt = 0.1) {
  current_time <- t0
  current_y <- y0
  
  times <- c(current_time)
  solutions <- matrix(current_y, nrow = 1)
  
  while (current_time < tfinal_max) {
    mass_ratio <- current_y[3] / satellite$mass_0
    height <- current_y[1]
    
    if (mass_ratio < 0.01 || height < 1000) {
      if (height < 1000) {
        cat(sprintf("  - Высота достигла %.0f м\n", height))
      }
      break
    }
    
    next_time <- min(current_time + dt, tfinal_max)
    
    result <- tryCatch({
      ode45(satellite_ode, current_time, next_time, current_y, omega_params = omega_params, 
            atol = 1e-8, hmax = 0.05)
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })
    

    current_time <- result$t[length(result$t)]
    current_y <- result$y[nrow(result$y), ]

    times <- c(times, result$t[-1])
    solutions <- rbind(solutions, result$y[-1, ])
  }
  
  return(list(t = times, y = solutions))
}

intensity_function <- function(t, y, omega_params) {
  v <- y[2]
  m <- y[3]
  T <- y[4]
  h <- y[1]
  
  
  # Скорость потери массы
  T_a <- atmosphere_temperature(h)
  rho_a <- atmosphere_density(h)
  
  
  omega_alpha <- omega_params[1]
  omega_beta <- omega_params[2]
  omega_gamma <- omega_params[3]
  
  max_omega <- max(omega_alpha, omega_beta, omega_gamma)
  if (max_omega > 1) {
    S_e <- satellite$surface_area / 4
  } else {
    S_e <- satellite$cross_section
  }
  
  dmdt <- 0
  if (!is.na(T) && !is.na(T_a) && T > T_a && T > 0) {
    exp_term <- exp(-constants$L * constants$mu / (constants$k_B * T))
    if (!is.na(exp_term) && is.finite(exp_term)) {
      dmdt <- S_e * constants$psi * 
        constants$P_a * exp(constants$L * constants$mu / (constants$k_B * constants$T_B)) * 
        exp_term / sqrt(2 * pi * constants$k_B * T / constants$mu)
    }
  }
  
  if (is.na(dmdt) || !is.finite(dmdt) || dmdt < 0) {
    dmdt <- 0
  }
  
  # Интенсивность излучения
  I <- constants$tau * dmdt * v^2 / 2
  
  return(I)
}

```

```{r}
objective_function_3d <- function(params) {
  omega_alpha <- params[1]
  omega_beta <- params[2]
  omega_gamma <- params[3]
  
  # В какой-то момент получаюся некоректные данные
  if (any(is.na(params)) || any(params <= 0) || any(params > 20)) {
    return(1e6)
  }
  
  y0 <- c(constants$h_0, constants$V_1, satellite$mass_0, constants$T_0)
  
  t0 <- 0
  tfinal_max <- 10
  
  result <- tryCatch({
    smart_integration(satellite_ode, t0, tfinal_max, y0, params)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })

  t_span <- result$t
  
  valid_indices <- which(t_span <= 5)
  if (length(valid_indices) < 5) {
    return(1e6)
  }
  
  t_span_limited <- t_span[valid_indices]
  y_limited <- result$y[valid_indices, ]
  
  # Вычисление интенсивности
  intensities <- numeric(length(t_span_limited))
  for (i in 1:length(t_span_limited)) {
    intensities[i] <- intensity_function(t_span_limited[i], y_limited[i, ], params)
  }
  
  # Нормализация и сравнение с экспериментальными данными
  baseline_intensity <- 900
  shadow_intensity <- baseline_intensity - intensities * 1e3
  
  # Интерполяция экспериментальных данных
  exp_intensity <- approx(shadow_data$Time, shadow_data$Intensity, 
                         xout = t_span_limited, rule = 2)$y
  
  # Среднеквадратичная ошибка
  error <- sqrt(mean((shadow_intensity - exp_intensity)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  return(error)
}
```


```{r}
initial_params <- c(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

result <- nloptr(
  x0 = initial_params,
  eval_f = objective_function_3d,
  lb = c(-10, -10, -10),
  ub = c(10, 10, 10),
  opts = list(
    algorithm = "NLOPT_LN_SBPLX",
    maxeval = 100,
    xtol_rel = 1e-6
  )
)

best_params <- result$solution
```

Угловые скорости: `r paste(round(best_params, 4), collapse = ", ")`

Минимальная ошибка: `r round(result$objective, 4)`

```{r}
y0 <- c(constants$h_0, constants$V_1, satellite$mass_0, constants$T_0)
t0 <- 0
tfinal_max <- 10

simulation <- smart_integration(satellite_ode, t0, tfinal_max, y0, best_params)

intensities <- numeric(length(simulation$t))
for (i in 1:length(simulation$t)) {
  intensities[i] <- intensity_function(simulation$t[i], simulation$y[i, ], best_params)
}

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(x = simulation$t, y = simulation$y[,3], 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Масса", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  layout(title = "Изменение массы спутника",
         xaxis = list(title = "Время (с)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Масса (кг)"))

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(x = simulation$t, y = simulation$y[,2], 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Скорость", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  layout(title = "Изменение скорости спутника",
         xaxis = list(title = "Время (с)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Скорость (м/с)"))

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(x = simulation$t, y = simulation$y[,4], 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Температура", line = list(color = "orange")) %>%
  layout(title = "Изменение температуры спутника",
         xaxis = list(title = "Время (с)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Температура (К)"))

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(x = simulation$t, y = intensities, 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Интенсивность", line = list(color = "green")) %>%
  layout(title = "Интенсивность излучения спутника",
         xaxis = list(title = "Время (с)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Интенсивность (Вт)"))

valid_indices <- which(simulation$t <= 5)
t_limited <- simulation$t[valid_indices]
intensities_limited <- intensities[valid_indices]

baseline_intensity <-0
scaling_factor <- -0.001
shadow_intensity <- baseline_intensity - intensities_limited * scaling_factor

plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(x = t_limited, y = shadow_intensity, 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Модель", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_trace(x = shadow_data$Time, y = shadow_data$Intensity, 
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            name = "Эксперимент", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  layout(title = "Сравнение теоретической и экспериментальной интенсивности",
         xaxis = list(title = "Время (с)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Яркость солнца (усл. ед.)"))

max_intensity <- max(intensities)
stellar_magnitude <- 6.8 - 1.086 * log(max_intensity)

print(paste("Максимальная интенсивность излучения:", round(max_intensity, 4), "Вт"))
print(paste("Звездная величина:", round(stellar_magnitude, 2)))

stars <- data.frame(
  name = c("Солнце", "Сириус", "Вега", "Антарес", "Альфард", "Альбирео", "Алдульфин", "Звезда Бесселя", "Сихэ"),
  magnitude = c(-26.7, -1.46, 0.03, 1.0, 2.0, 3.08, 4.03, 5.21, 6.04)
)

closest_star_idx <- which.min(abs(stars$magnitude - stellar_magnitude))
closest_star <- stars$name[closest_star_idx]
closest_magnitude <- stars$magnitude[closest_star_idx]

print(paste("Ближайшая по яркости звезда:", closest_star, 
            "со звездной величиной", closest_magnitude))
```
